items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 27:1
items.html: (To the question) What is speech? The inner Partzuf of the Nukva is called speech. And when the inner Partzuf departs from her and she remains only in the external, which is VAK, then she is called mute, without speech. (Item 183).
